0022600139.text: The Timberwolves (3-1, 3rd in the Northwest, 1 game back, 6th in the West) host the Warriors (1-3, 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back, 12th in the West) in Minnesota's fifth game of the season, coming off a 1-game losing streak after going 3-1 over their last ten. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), while Golden State is missing Gui Santos (knee tendinitis), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and the last meeting 127-117 in San Francisco on March 13, 2026, and no games between these teams have been played yet in 2026-27.
